text:
alex: Heads-up: discovered CVE-2026-1984 in libyaml used by our private image builder. It's a deserialization issue that can lead to RCE in the YAML loader used by the onprem agent.

maria: ugh. which images? hosted/dedicated/private?

alex: mainly Private & Dedicated customer images that still run infra-agent v1.12 and image-builder v0.9. They parse customer config YAML during startup. Hosted envs already on v1.15 with patched dependency.

tom: can we patch without a full image rebuild? any hotpatch available?

alex: upstream fix is a minor bump to libyaml 0.3.12 but our binary bundles are linked => requires rebuild and re-sign. No safe hotpatch for older runtime due to ABI.

jen: distro/time cost: for Private we often need customer-specific images. What's our plan for backporting and ship flow?

alex: proposal:
- create a backport branch for each affected major (v1.12, v1.13)
- update libyaml dep, run unit+integration + customer smoke tests
- produce signed airgap bundle + SBOM
- coordinate with customer to schedule restart (VPC/onprem) or provide remote patching option if allowed

maria: note: a couple of customers (acme, fincorp) forbid inbound fetches, so airgap bundle is mandatory. Also they require audit log of patch install with KMS-wrapped signatures.

tom: on KMS: does Private use customer KMS/HSM or our platform KMS for image signing?

jen: design docs: Private supports customer-managed KMS but image-signing in earlier releases used our platform KMS. We need to add option to sign image manifests with customer KMS keys during backport builds.

alex: open questions for infra:
- Can our build pipeline support signing with external KMS (via transient service account)?
- Will S3 audit log uploads work from airgapped client, or do we need customer to push logs to our collector endpoint?

deploy-bot: CI triggered: backport-libyaml-v1.12 started by @alex. Build id: bld-20260319-4123

maria: For prioritization: rank this P1 for customers on v1.12 in production. Hosted already done. Let's create work items: backport-v1.12, backport-v1.13, airgap-bundle-docs, kms-signing-infra.

jen: I'll start the backport branch for v1.12 and open PR. tagging @tom for build infra changes.

tom: ack. I'll draft KMS signing adapter and a runbook for airgap distribution + verification steps (include `cosign` verification snippet). Expect PR by EOD.

alex: thanks. also add note to release notes: which optional RBAC changes? this CVE doesn't require RBAC tweak but we should log audit events on patch apply: `PATCH_APPLY` with actor/service-account, key-id, image-digest.

security-bot: New CVE record created: CVE-2026-1984; severity: HIGH; affected-releases: v1.12,v1.13; ticket: SEC-2026-0421

maria: assign SEC-2026-0421 to @alex and @tom. Support ops, please prepare customer comms template for acme/finCorp. Use plain checklist for onprem installers.

jen: created PR 672 with patch and smoke tests. link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/platform/merge_requests/672

alex: cool. schedule canary for dedicated first (non-customer pinned pools) then private customer images after acceptance. :thumbsup:

maria: +1. We'll track in the weekly security sync. closing initial triage here.
